description: This file defines a test class InstallTester extending Codeception's Actor class, containing methods for automating the installation process of SuiteCRM via web interface, including license acceptance, system environment verification, database configuration, and finalization tasks.

classes.name: InstallTester
classes.description: A test actor class for automating SuiteCRM installation steps through web interface interactions, including license acceptance, environment checks, database setup, and finalization.

methods.name: maySeeOldVersionDetected
methods.description: Checks if an old PHP version warning is detected and proceeds through the installation steps accordingly.

methods.name: acceptLicense
methods.description: Automates acceptance of license agreement and moves to the next installation step.

methods.name: seeValidSystemEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies the system environment step and proceeds to the database configuration.

methods.name: configureInstaller
methods.description: Configures the installation wizard based on a WebDriver helper's database settings and advances to the next step.

methods.name: waitForInstallerToFinish
methods.description: Waits for the installation process to complete before proceeding.

methods.name: dontSeeMissingLabels
methods.description: Checks that UI labels starting with 'LBL_' are not present, indicating no missing labels.

methods.name: dontSeeErrors
methods.description: Verifies that no error or warning messages are visible on the current page.

methods.name: isOldPhpVersionDetected
methods.description: Executes JavaScript to determine if an old PHP version warning is present in the interface.
